Pattern: repeated prefix-matching if-else chains across multiple functions with the same set of prefixes (HTTPoison, Ecto, Phoenix, Tesla, Req., Code., System.cmd, :os.cmd, Port.open).

Just did this for elixir_extractor.ml (determine_severity, get_rule_name, get_category, get_suggestion → sink_table + classify_sink). Look for similar patterns in:

1. src/ocaml/lib/catseye_engine/constants.ml — known_sources, known_sanitizers lists
2. src/ocaml/lib/catseye_engine/path_sensitivity.ml — validation/auth guard detection
3. src/ocaml/lib/catseye_engine/propagate.ml — string_taint_methods, operator handling
4. src/ocaml/lib/catseye_il/cfg_taint.ml — check_call_sinks, language filter chains
5. KDL rule files in rules/ — repeated language filter blocks
6. scripts/elixir-extractor/lib/catseye_extractor.ex — @ssrf_sinks, @sql_sinks, @xss_sinks, @code_exec_sinks lists (could be a single data structure)

Goal: each cluster of related if-else/contains checks becomes a single data table + one lookup function. New sinks/categories only need a new table row.

title: Refactor: replace repetitive if-else chains with data-driven lookup tables
